tracks.title: Aperture
tracks.description: Hub theme: felt piano states the D–A–E motif, warm pads, glass light, a restrained pulse; the motif returns harmonised.

tracks.title: Constellation
tracks.description: Map exploration: slowly evolving pads, scattered glass stars from the D pentatonic, the motif once.

tracks.title: Assembly
tracks.description: Labs and missions: an understated pulse with sparse fifth-stack filament figures; never a constant arpeggio.

tracks.title: Observatory
tracks.description: Research notebook: warm minimal felt piano, one chord per bar, long patient silences.

tracks.title: Quiet Field
tracks.description: Optional study ambience: very slow pad changes on D, a faint drone and air. No melody, no percussion.

tracks.title: Breakthrough
tracks.description: Mastery flourish (non-looping): the motif rolled on felt piano, doubled on glass, over a Dmaj9 bloom.
